citations.title: Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley Announce Landmark $63 Billion Financing Structure to Enable AI Compute Capacity in Partnership with Broadcom | Broadcom Inc.
excerpts: NEW YORK and CHARLOTTE, N.C. and PALO ALTO, Calif. , Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bank of America (NYSE: BAC), Blackstone (NYSE: BX), Citi (NYSE: C) and Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS) (the " Lead Financial Partners ") today announced a $63 billion transaction to enable the deployment of AI compute capacity, leveraging Broadcom Inc.'s (NASDAQ: AVGO) technology, for Anthropic . This transaction is part of the strategic compute capacity agreement previously announced by Broadcom , with expected deliveries starting in calendar 2027. citations.title: Anthropic opens Singapore office, signs AI safety agreement with government
excerpts: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/a-khan-content-strategist/) | 19 October 2026

Anthropic has opened a new office in Singapore and signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the Ministry of Digital Development and Information to strengthen cooperation on AI safety, security, model evaluation and responsible artificial intelligence adoption. Announced on October 14, 2026, the expansion marks Anthropic’s fifth office in Asia-Pacific, as the company deepens its presence in one of its most active markets for its AI assistant, Claude. The agreement was signed by Kai Fong Chng, permanent secretary of Singapore’s Ministry of Digital Development and Information, and Anthropic co-founder Ben Mann on the sidelines of Singapore International Cyber Week. Singapore’s Minister for Digital Development and Information Josephine Teo and Anthropic’s head of APAC policy, Michael Sellitto, witnessed the signing. Under the MOU, Anthropic and the Singapore government will collaborate on AI safety and security research, model testing and evaluation standards, incident response, and research into AI adoption and its economic impact. The partnership will also support responsible AI deployment across public and private sector organisations.
The Singapore office is now open and recruiting, according to the company.

basis.reasoning: The October 19 report identifies the office opening and agreement event on October 14 and confirms the office is open. Confidence is medium because the event date comes from secondary reporting.
